scope: Bounded Act 1 prop clarity audit and preparation package

target_visual_brief.summary: Warm top-down Sonoran neighborhood adventure. Interactables should read from silhouette first; wider map/GPS/world-scale affordances should clarify route scale without clutter or debug-like dots.

current_runtime_note: The current working tree already includes runtime-integrated prop clarity assets and prior before/after evidence. This imported package does not approve those assets or promote additional art; it records the highest-visibility placeholder/provenance risks, keeps replacement candidates as draft-only AssetRegistry records, and prepares follow-up IDs/specs.

recommended_scope: Either explicitly except each currently integrated prop clarity asset with provenance evidence, or replace it with approved Aseprite-authored art through AssetRegistry.
Keep static GPS/HUD anchors in public/layouts/neighborhood.layout.json before scene code references them.
Preserve current interaction ids, collision, prompts, and Act 1 quest flow.
Capture true before/after screenshots and only mark final_judgment improved when a child-facing runtime screenshot is visibly clearer.
follow_up_replacement_package.approval_gate: No draft id may be promoted until approved source exists, runtime screenshots prove it loaded through AssetRegistry, placeholder fallback remains intact, and visual improvement is judged from screenshots.
